newsitem.title: UK: London Hong Kong stocks dip ahead of U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: London Hong Kong stocks dip ahead of U.S. data.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London were modestly lower in a quiet session on Thursday as Friday's closely-watched U.S. monthly employment data kept investors sidelined, traders said.
In early afternoon the Hang Seng London reference index was 11.02 points lower at 12,466.54 with investors looking to Wall Street for direction.
Weaker-than-expected weekly jobs data helped push the U.S. Treasury market better, helping lift Hong Kong shares in London off the day's lows.
"The U.S. numbers pushed things slightly better for choice but aside from that there's been nothing going on," said a London dealer.
In Hong Kong overnight, the Hang Seng index ended 72.09 points higher at 12,477.56 after a see-saw session ahead of Friday's U.S. data.
